This block runs from 3.9 weeks out into Hyrox race week, so it is an arrival block, not a general build. Weeks 1-2 sharpen race pace and transitions, Week 3 cuts volume, and Week 4 is about arriving fresh. Squat and pulling strength stay at minimum reliable maintenance, and the Friday run keeps half-marathon durability without trying to peak that race. Keep any separate Hyrox practice technical/easy, not a third hard session.

Weeks 2-4: the race paces stay basically fixed on purpose; Week 2 links more race work, then Weeks 3-4 strip volume away so you keep the feel without carrying fatigue. After Hyrox, the next two weeks should rebuild one longer easy run and one controlled half-marathon-pace touch, but that is outside this block.

Achilles rule: do not add off-plan runs. If it grumbles, first shorten or replace the Friday run or any extra running you added yourself; keep Monday race-pace work only if pain stays at or under 2/10 and is back to baseline the next morning. If stride shortens or splits fall away, end the set instead of forcing it.

START_WEEK1_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Mon	[WARMUP] Run	Easy pace	1	8 min	N/A	3	Easy jog plus ankle and hip prep for transitions.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12	
Mon	Rowing Ergometer	1:52-1:50/500 m	2	500 m	2:00	7	Smooth and controlled, not a test; if split drifts more than 2 seconds, hold there and finish clean.	
Mon	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	90s	7	Support pulling work; stop 1 rep before shoulder shrugging starts.	
Mon	Seated Calf Raise	RPE-selected load	3	12	60s	7	Tendon capacity work; full pause top and bottom.	
Mon	Ski Erg	1:50/500 m	4	250 m	1:45	7	Clean strokes only; if you drift slower than 1:51 twice, stop at 3 reps.	
Mon	Burpee Broad Jump	Race rhythm	3	20 m	0:00	7	Go straight into the next run; keep rhythm even, not maximal.	
Mon	Run	4:08-4:12/km	3	600 m	2:30	7.5	Off Burpee Broad Jump; if you cannot regain race posture by 150 m, end the set there.	
Tue	[WARMUP] Run	Easy pace	1	6 min	N/A	3	Easy jog plus shoulder prep.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12	
Tue	Medicine Ball Scoop Throw	Light ball	3	3	60s	N/A	Full reset between reps; keep every throw fast.	
Tue	Wall Ball	Race ball	2	20	90s	7	Race rhythm, leave a couple of reps in reserve; if the first set is sloppy, stop at 15 and repeat next week.	
Tue	Pull-up	Bodyweight + RPE-selected load	3	4	2:00	7	Pulling maintenance; if shoulders feel heavy from sport, stay at bodyweight.	
Tue	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	2	10/side	45s	6	Trunk brace, not fatigue.	
Tue	Sled Pull	90-95% race load	4	15 m	90s	7	Crisp hand-over-hand pulls; if footing slips, keep load and cut one set.	
Wed	[WARMUP] Deep Squat Hold	Bodyweight	1	60s	N/A	2	Then take normal bar warm-up sets to 115 kg.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Ramp Back Squat: 45 kg x 5, 70 kg x 3, 90 kg x 1-2 before 115 kg work sets.	
Wed	Medicine Ball Scoop Throw	Light ball	3	3	60s	N/A	Primer only; stop before speed drops.	
Wed	Back Squat	115 kg	2	2	3:00	6.5	About 77% of your 150 max; maintenance only. If RPE goes past 7.5 or bar speed slows, keep 115 and stop after set 2.	
Wed	Sandbag Lunge	90-95% race load	3	25 m	2:00	7	Tall torso and even steps; if balance or knee tracking fades, stop the rep early and keep the load.	
Wed	Side Plank	Bodyweight	2	35s/side	45s	6	Short, clean trunk work.	
Wed	Prowler Push	90-95% race load	4	15 m	90s	7	Hyrox sled push posture; if the sled stalls, keep load and shorten the rep slightly.	
Wed	Farmer Carry	90-95% race load	3	60 m	2:00	7	One clean pickup each rep; if grip slips early, break the distance once without adding load.	
Fri	[WARMUP] Run	Easy pace	1	5 min	N/A	3	Easy jog and calf prep.	
Fri	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	2	6	2:00	6-7	Crisp lockout; if low back takes over, reduce load.	
Fri	Machine Hamstring Curl	RPE-selected load	2	10	75s	7	Smooth squeeze, no cramping grind.	
Fri	Seated Calf Raise	RPE-selected load	2	15	60s	6-7	Easy tendon touch before the run.	
Fri	Run	4:50-5:20/km	1	45 min	N/A	4-5	Conversational only; if Achilles gets grumbly after 20 min, stop at 35 and walk 5 min.	
END_WEEK1_TSV

TAPER AUDIT
Event: hybrid race, priority A, about 3.9 weeks out.
This block runs into the event: the final week is competition week.
Sport sessions counted as load: 2 per week.
WEEK PHASES: 1=realization 2=realization 3=taper 4=competition_week EVENT=hybrid_race

    phase             sets  exercises  competition lift  power sets  peak RPE  peak % max
W1  realization       55    18         -                 9           7.5       -
W2  realization       42    17         -                 7           7.5       -
W3  taper             39    13         -                 18          7         -
W4  competition week  19    11         -                 5           7         -

Across the block: volume -36 sets, exercises -7, competition-lift share unchanged, peak effort -0.5 RPE, accessory volume -15 sets.
